svg.title: Zynara Health · Care Approval IQ — Technical Architecture
svg.text: H E A L T H
receives the request and queues it — nothing more
persistent · gpt-4.1 class · prose & judgement only · File Search grounded · deterministic stub twin per agent (CI)

g.text: Matches the case to appeals that
won before — and drafts this one.
Durable Functions · sequences all 5 deterministic checks · keyed on request id (idempotent)
Owns every value that drives a decision — auto-submit vs. Reviewer is decided here; the Gate reads its output

svg.text: ✓ every submit & every appeal is human-approved

g.text: readiness ≥ θ ∧ no missing criteria ∧ value ≤ auto-limit
→ auto-submit the draft, else route to the Reviewer
the ONLY actor that touches a payer

svg.text: the region switch flips the payer rule-set & appeal path — shown live in the demo
applies across every layer above, not just one

g.text: SQL · Foundry · Storage — no stored secrets
holds only the App Insights + content-share strings
one correlated trace id per request id, every hop
every agent call metered → £/$ on the dashboard
scripted scenarios scored offline, gated in CI
a person approves every outbound action
never set a value, code or date — deterministic code does

svg.text: Zynara Health (fictional) · Care Approval IQ · Proof beats paperwork.
